game.title: Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties
game.blurb: Action-adventure brawler, a remake of Yakuza 3 paired with a second story, Dark Ties, from Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio (per StrategyWiki; RAWG lists no developer), released 2026-02-12. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0; its Walkthrough links Chapter 1 to 15, but only Chapter 1, Chapter 2 and Chapter 12 exist as subpages, with Gameplay, Reaper, Walkthrough and Table of Contents; "Dark Ties", "Substories" and "Minigames" are linked but not written. yakuza.fandom.com has no page under "Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties"; "Yakuza Kiwami 3" redirects to "Yakuza Kiwami 3 and Dark Ties", with about 104 links, including chapter pages, "Dark Ties/Chapter 1" to "Dark Ties/Chapter 3", "Bad Boy Dragon" and "Life at Morning Glory"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Biscus" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 3937550. RAWG lists no developer or publisher; the developer name comes from StrategyWiki's page links. 16 of 62 Steam achievements are hidden: 15 in a row (2 to 16) look like story chapters, and "Defying Fate" (35, 16.7%) sits among side content; all sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder, and it is not known which, if any, belong to Dark Ties. The Dark Ties chapter is placed by Mine and Kanda in the achievement text.
